name: Raj Srinivasan
headline: Managing Director at Crowe | Oracle NetSuite Leader
about:
Summary: Raj is a Managing Director in the NetSuite consulting services group at Crowe. Raj specializes in providing Business Transformation and System Implementation consulting services via NetSuite ERP. In his current role as Managing Director, Raj is responsible for operations and delivery of NetSuite services. Raj is also responsible for leading the NetSuite technical center of excellence and focuses on building innovative applications with seamless integration with NetSuite ERP

Raj has 12+ years of extensive experience in leading and architecting Global NetSuite ERP implementations. Hands-on experience in the full life cycle of NetSuite implementation process which includes business requirements gathering, prototyping, proof of concept, solutioning and design, implementation, development, testing, training and maintenance. Raj led, managed and played multiple key roles in global implementation rollouts across various verticals and industries in the US, EMEA, JAPAC and LATAM regions.

Expertise: Systems Architecture | NetSuite Architecture | Systems Integration | NetSuite Integration | Acquisition Integration | Accounting & Operations| ERP | CRM | NetSuite OneWorld | Business Process Management | Global Team Management

Verticals: Services, Professional Services, Software/SaaS, General Business, Entertainment, Advertising, Media and Publishing, EdTech

Functional Modules: Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, General Ledger, Advanced Financials, Advanced Revenue Management (ARM), Multi-Book Accounting, Project Accounting, SuiteProjects, CRM, Banking Automation, NetSuite OneWorld and Global Consolidation

Technical Modules: SuiteAnalytics, SuiteFlow, SuiteScript, SuiteBuilder, SuiteTalk (SOAP, REST)

3rd Party Integrations: Salesforce Integration, Tax automation, A/P automation, Payment automation, Compliance automation, Other SuiteApps

iPaaS: Celigo, Jitterbit, Workato, Boomi

CRM: Salesforce and D365

International Work Experience: Germany, Switzerland
